title: Log tool-source discovery failures instead of an empty catch in installed-connectors
description: packages/adapters/src/installed-connectors.ts discoverInstall() (~lines 204-206) swallows every discovery failure (auth, network, schema parse) with an empty, unlogged catch, so a broken user-installed tool source silently contributes zero tools. Log the error with the source id/kind and keep the other sources loading. Split out of vykean T-VYK-194 (the task named a keel loader; the only such loader is here). Luke approved 2026-09-13. Found by the T-VYK-194 lane: ~/dev/onlytools/keel/.worktrees/t-vyk-194/proof/T-VYK-194/QUESTION.md.
